achievements.name: Ouroboros
achievements.detail: Awaken the paired fusion in the early story and transform during a fight.

achievements.name: Distant Colony
achievements.detail: Travel to a colony outside the starting regions and meet the people living there.

achievements.name: The City
achievements.detail: Locate the independent settlement and pass through its front gate.

achievements.name: Hero Ally
achievements.detail: Finish a hero's quest and add that hero's class to the party.

achievements.name: Full Arts
achievements.detail: Fight as one class until every art on its palette is learned.

achievements.name: Interlink
achievements.detail: Transform a linked pair mid-battle and strike an enemy before the fusion timer ends.

achievements.name: Chain Attack
achievements.detail: Fill the chain gauge and spend it on a chain attack during a fight.

achievements.name: Unique Monster
achievements.detail: Track a named monster in the field and defeat it.

achievements.name: Freed Colony
achievements.detail: Finish one colony's quest line so its flame clock releases the residents.

achievements.name: Ascension Quest
achievements.detail: Clear a hero ascension quest and raise that class beyond its first rank limit.

achievements.name: Erythia Sea
achievements.detail: Cross the inland sea by boat and step onto a shore in the next region.

achievements.name: Last Chapter
achievements.detail: Finish the final story chapter and keep watching until the credits end.
